title: Elementary School Districts — complete CensusTIGER2026 unapproved successor draft

parameters.coverage: all25 state publications in exact official2026ELSD directory; elementary districts only, no unified/secondary districts or fabricated territories
parameters.geometry: native EPSG4269 Polygon/MultiPolygon WKB, no repair, wrapping, simplification or reprojection
parameters.raw_dbf: all original DBF names/types/widths/null conventions retained in raw archives/audit; blank C fields decode to source-driver NULL, leading characters retained
parameters.record_lineage: metadata/source_record_lineage.jsonl binds each original GEOID/OGC_FID to its literal ZIP/member/raw pin; archive filename is never added to the main data schema
parameters.source_identifiers: STATEFP, ELSDLEA, GEOID, GEOIDFQ and file-local OGC_FID retained exactly; no published-ID substitution

parameters.ALAND_AWATER: original N14,0 integer values retained as int64, never float
